name: AWeber
description: Reliable email marketing and landing page builder with 24/7 support and built-in Canva design tools.
fullDescription: AWeber has provided rock-solid email marketing infrastructure for over two decades. Featuring direct integration with Canva for rapid banner creation, automated RSS-to-email broadcasting, and high inbox delivery rates, AWeber is a dependable choice for newsletters and product updates.
features: Built-in Canva image design integration directly within the email builder
Auto-newsletter feature that broadcasts new blog posts and product releases
Free plan supporting up to 500 subscribers with core automation features
Custom landing page creator with integrated Stripe payment processing
Detailed open rate, click-through, and link tracking analytics
